messages:
Andrew (partnerships): Heads up — CloudMarketplace just pushed an updated allocation. Our reserved A100s got auctioned in front, so delivery is now split and ETA slipped. This impacts Dedicated commits for EU customers.
Maria (ops): Link to the allocation note?
Andrew (partnerships): https://cloudmarketplace.example/allocations/CM-5987 (internal link) — shows first tranche 40% arriving Apr 20, remainder May 5.
Tina (supply-chain): I already pinged the marketplace PM. Their reply: 'manifest constraints forced split; can expedite remainder for a fee; no cancel option.'
Akash (sales): We have three customers with Dedicated start dates Apr 25–27 in EU. If we miss the first tranche we miss SLAs. Any temporary workarounds?
Leo (platform): We can route traffic to EU-hosted spare pools in another region temporarily, but latency may increase ~20–40ms. Also capacity there is limited — need permission to drain non-critical burst workloads.
Sophie (legal): Cross-region failover for customers requires opt-in or an emergency waiver. How long would this be?
Leo (platform): Probably 72–96 hours to cover the gap.
Maria (ops): We need a single proposal to present to customers: either cross-region fallback (72h) or prorated credits + later onboarding. Which does sales prefer?
Akash (sales): Customers prefer availability over a small latency hit. We'll ask customers to sign a 72h cross-region SLA addendum (we can self-certify). I'll draft language if legal ok.
Sophie (legal): I can draft a 72h emergency addendum. Need explicit customer consent recorded.
Andrew (partnerships): Parallel ask to marketplace: request expedited transfer without fee or a capped expedite fee + written confirmation of revised manifest and tracking. Tina, can you own?
Tina (supply-chain): On it. Opened ticket CM-5987 and escalated to logistics lead. Vendor response pasted below: `OrionSupply: we can reassign 16 GPUs from UK lot 23 to your EU rack; ETA Apr 22 if expedite fee accepted (estimated €8k). Otherwise remainder arrives May 5.`
Andrew (partnerships): Can we accept 16 to cover the largest customer? Which customers map to that count?
Akash (sales): Yes — that covers Customer A (largest) and gives breathing room for Customer B with temporary hosted burst. I'll re-run the allocation mapping and confirm which customers to prioritize.
Maria (ops): Actionable checklist: 1) Tina negotiate fee cap (target €4k) and push for written manifest; 2) Leo enable cross-region fallback windows; 3) Sophie prepare 72h addendum; 4) Akash notify customers with opt-in form.
Tina (supply-chain): Update: logistics lead said they can meet a €5k cap if we commit in 2 hours. Need sign-off.
Andrew (partnerships): Approve up to €5k if it prevents SLA breaches. Akash, confirm customers to prioritize within 30m.
Akash (sales): Confirmed: prioritize Customer A and Customer C. I'll send opt-in notices and ask for 72h fallback consent.
orion-bot: Deploy bot note — created ticket: CM-5987, priority HIGH, assignee @Tina (supply-chain).
Maria (ops): I'll prepare an internal routing playbook and update the Console routing policy to give automatic fallback to eu-west-spare for the affected routes.
Leo (platform): I'll add a transient circuit-breaker: if latency >150ms or error rate increases, revert to original routing and notify ops.
Sophie (legal): Draft addendum ready in 45 minutes; will post for review.
Andrew (partnerships): Good triage. Final decision: authorize €5k expedite, enable 72h cross-region fallback, send customer notices, and get written manifest from marketplace. I'll follow up with marketplace PM and loop in partnership execs. :eyes: :shipit:
Akash (sales): Sending notices now.
Tina (supply-chain): Sending commitment to vendor now — will paste confirmation when received.
Maria (ops): I'll run a smoke test of the fallback path once Leo flips the routing.
orion-bot: Ticket CM-5987 updated: vendor confirmed partial reassign, ETA Apr 22, expedite fee €5k, manifest pending.
Andrew (partnerships): Thanks team — keep updates in this thread. We should also add a short retro after resolution to lock in marketplace penalties language for future reserved deals.
Akash (sales): Agreed — push for marketplace SLA clause on reserved capacity split.
Sophie (legal): Noted for contract playbook.
Maria (ops): Status check in 2 hours.
Leo (platform): Will post routing test results in this thread.
